Hero_Desc_Canta:
A sprite who runs a spinning top house in the back alley of the Sprite Kingdom.
She seems to have enough skill to be called the number one in the top spinning world.
She's always looking for a chance to move her top house to the banquet hall.
Album_Wish_Canta: Creating the ultimate invincible spinning top.
Album_Canta1: While wandering around the Sprite Kingdom, I saw a group of kids playing with spinning tops. Finding them rather cute, I approached to watch—only to witness one sprite, Canta, completely shatter an opponent's top and demand they hand over their house as payment for losing the bet. I couldn't help but think... kids these days play a little too aggressively.
Album_Canta2: Canta takes immense pride in the magic tops she crafts. She eagerly showed them off to me, saying that if I wanted, she could make me one too. Then she casually mentioned, "How about we wager the Order building on a top battle?" I...should probably avoid this.
Album_Canta3: The sprites in the Order warned me that Canta is infamous for playing tops in a "brutal" way. If you get caught up in her games, it's said to be a huge headache. They strongly advised me not to get too friendly with her.
Album_Canta4: Canta seems to have quite a broad social circle. She claims to have one friend among the witches and another among the dragons, but no matter how much I ask, she refuses to tell me who they are. She calls it a "secret club," which makes me wonder if she's hiding something. Maybe she'll introduce them to me one day...?
Album_Canta5: Canta regularly hosts spinning top tournaments at her home. It seemed like a fun little festival, so I decided to check it out with some of the other Apostles. The sprites eagerly participated, but one by one, their tops were shattered, and they lost their bets to Canta. Of course, I wasn't spared either.
Album_Canta6: One day, a group of Apostles came to me, claiming they had lost their homes. I confronted Canta, telling her to stop running illegal top battles and return the houses. She gave me a cryptic response: "Just this once because it's you asking." What does that even mean?
Album_Canta7: Canta seems to be carefully watching Ner's reactions as she skillfully toes the line, luring Apostles from the Order into top battles. Ner, on the other hand, seems to be waiting for the right moment to give Canta a proper lesson. Now, I need to decide—do I warn Canta and side with her, or do I keep my conscience clean?
LoveHero_Canta: Master, d'you want to learn how to spin tops well?
LoveHeroCancel_Canta: Bah, give back all the tops I gave you!
Food_ChefNote_Canta_Hate1: She handed over an empty spinning top as a token of gratitude for the cutlet. In the midst of my confusion, Canta had already run off into the distance.
Food_ChefNote_Canta_Hate2: Canta complained that the tea cools down too quickly when she's spinning tops. Then why doesn't she drink the tea before playing tops...?
Food_ChefNote_Canta_Like1: Excited for some reason, Canta began spinning the can with the spinning top stick. How did she even do that...?
Food_ChefNote_Canta_Like2: After quickly devouring the cake, Canta proposed trading her spinning tops for extra pieces of cake. She could have just said so, if she wanted more...
Food_ChefNote_Canta_Like3: After observing the rice cake soup closely, Canta got excited that she could make a spinning top modeled after it. It seems her spinning top skills come from her craftsmanship.
Food_ChefNote_Canta_Like4: I barely managed to stop Canta from taking her carving knife to carve the Bûche de Noël into a top. It seems that she had mistaken the cake for real wood.
Food_ChefNote_Canta_Like5: Canta said she could taste the thrill and tang of winning a spinning top battle. However, she added that she wouldn't give up her tops.
Food_ChefNote_Canta_Like6: Canta said, their colorful features clustered together reminded her of a spinning top duel. I barely stopped her from drawing her top stick instinctively.
Food_ChefNote_Canta_Like7: Canta said that even with such an amazing dessert, she couldn't overlook spinning top battles. Judging by the smile she couldn't hide, it seems she really liked it.
Food_ChefNote_Canta_Like8: Canta packed extra YumYumVitC as a refreshment when a duel isn't going well. She seems to truly love top duels.
Food_ChefNote_Canta_Like9: Canta asked if this was the loot from spinning top duels. She must've mistaken the candy for marbles. Once she realized they were candy, she enjoyed them.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Canta: My top hasn't been illegally modified, see?
Gacha_Result_Line1_Canta: Want to spin a top? Come try, it's fun!
Canta_Spawn1: I brought out a legal top this time, see?
Canta_Growth1: Come see! Haven't I grown a lot?
Canta_Growth2: I never wanted to become this strong.
Canta_Victory1: What? This isn't a top duel?
Canta_Victory2: Well, I just spun it just a couple of times, then I won! Hehehe!
Canta_Defeat1: You won't take my top, will you?
Canta_Defeat2: This duel was the top of the top!
Canta_Affinity1_2: Do you think you can beat me?
Canta_Affinity2: If you lose, you have to break your top. Hand it over!
Canta_Affinity3: The only thing ruling the cold back alleys of the kingdom is the endlessly spinning top!
Canta_Affinity4: I'm holding a huge match at my house this time. If you have time, come watch.
Canta_Affinity5: This is a new spinning top I made... What do you think? It even emits fire!
Canta_Affinity6: A fidget spinner? How dare you compare my spinning top with that?!
Canta_Affinity7: I'll give you a formal chance to join. Choose one, the Order or our top cartel?
Canta_Die1: Keep hitting it so it doesn't fall over!
Canta_Equipment: Is this for modding spinning tops? I like it.
Canta_HeroSkill: You spin it with skill, not strength.
Canta_HeroUpgrade: I'm becoming a master class spinner.
Canta_Board: What a nice board we got here!
Canta_DeckSetting1: This is a great spot for spinning.
Canta_DeckSetting2: Could you get out of my way?
Canta_Touch1: Ah! Don't pull me, pull the shooter!
Canta_Touch1_1: Gah... I let you pull once, so you let me win the next round, okay?
Canta_Touch2_1: I'm not the type to allow someone touch my head so easily.
Canta_Touch1_2: I don't care about this kind of game!
Canta_Touch2: Should I take care of my spinning tops like this too?
Canta_DutchRubEnd2: Ugh! Yer supposed to smack the spinning top, not me!
Canta_Ultimate1: What kind of magic should I put on this top?
Canta_Pleasure2: That is it! Just like that!
Canta_Birthday: I hear today is a good day. Congratulations.
Canta_Gacha2: Want to spin a top? It is fun!
Canta_Gacha3: My top hasn't been illegally modified, see?
Canta_Greeting: Oh, a new face. Want to spin a top?
Canta_Line1: How about a round of top spinning?
Canta_Line3: What kind of magic should I put on this top?
Canta_Lobby: Ah, I want to spin a top.
LoveLetter_Canta:
Master. It is me, the God of Spinning Tops.

You have a talent for surprising me. The first time was when we had our spinning-top match. You did not look the type, so I was surprised to discover you had some experience.

The second time was when you helped me make up with my friends. I assumed you disliked me too, so I never expected you to work that hard for us.

But when are you going to keep your promise to help me find a place for Cantapia? I am still waiting here, you know. Huh? You really will?
LoveCall_Canta:
Hey, Master! It is me, the Spinning Top Master!
I was enjoying another incredible match in the back alley today when you suddenly came to mind.
I have been on an eight-match winning streak since yesterday. Impressive, right?
My spinning-top skills just keep growing!

Come to think of it, is it not time you joined this heated competition too?
If you visit my place, I will even give you a special top sharpened to a perfect edge!
Oh, and do not worry. It is definitely not an illegal modification.

Hurry over, watch the tops spin, and cool your head for a while.
What? Instead of cooling down, your head might start spinning too? Haha! Maybe it will!
Affinity_Canta_EP01_001: Everyone misunderstands me. I may cheat, but I never fix a match.
Affinity_Canta_EP01_003: What? No! Cheating is slightly less terrible!
Affinity_Canta_EP01_005: Exactly! I refuse to associate with anyone who fixes matches.
Affinity_Canta_EP01_006: Are they not the same? Why are you boasting about this?
Affinity_Canta_EP01_007: They are completely different! Match-fixing means deciding the result before the contest even begins!
Affinity_Canta_EP02_001: I heard there is a legendary top somewhere in Elias.
Affinity_Canta_EP02_002: A legendary top? It is still merely a toy...
Affinity_Canta_EP02_003: Do you know how much one can do with a top?! It is no ordinary toy!
Affinity_Canta_EP02_004: I saw one for about three thousand at a Monatium stationery shop.
Affinity_Canta_EP02_005: Wh-What?! The Elves are selling it for three thousand Elif?!
Affinity_Canta_EP02_006: Forget finding it. Customize your own top into a legend.
Affinity_Canta_EP02_007: Oh? That sounds rather convincing. My cherished top must be stronger than some top another person discarded, right?
Affinity_Canta_EP03_001: Snorky and Pira... They say they went straight, so they rarely play with me anymore.
Affinity_Canta_EP03_002: Why do you not go straight too?
Affinity_Canta_EP03_003: Why should I? My top arena is only ambiguously illegal!
Affinity_Canta_EP03_004: Snorky left the underworld. Do not tempt her back onto the wrong path!
Affinity_Canta_EP03_005: Playing with Snorky was the most entertaining... Sigh~ I suppose nothing lasts forever.
Affinity_Canta_EP03_006: Pira left the underworld. Do not tempt her back onto the wrong path!
Affinity_Canta_EP03_007: Hehe. Pira? Do you truly believe she went straight? She will escape the moment an opportunity appears.
Affinity_Canta_EP04_001: Why are you so kind to your subordinates? Strike them like tops, and they will work hard.
Affinity_Canta_EP04_002: You are my subordinate too. Shall I strike you?
Affinity_Canta_EP04_003: W-Wait! Was I not an officer~? I will run away if you hit me!
Affinity_Canta_EP04_004: Someone else handles the striking, you might say. Do not worry.
Affinity_Canta_EP04_005: Huh? You have a separate enforcer? D-Do not tell me the High Priest is your enforcer?!
Affinity_Canta_EP04_006: Corporal punishment is not an especially good method, Canta.
Affinity_Canta_EP04_007: Really? Do praise and kindness make people work better? Perhaps I should try that once.
Affinity_Canta_EP05_001: Did you know wooden and stone tops are better than commercial ones?
Affinity_Canta_EP05_002: That is not a fact I especially wanted to learn.
Affinity_Canta_EP05_003: Now that you know, remember it well from now on.
Affinity_Canta_EP05_004: I do not care. I will confiscate all of them. They are mine now!
Affinity_Canta_EP05_005: No! Stop! I made those tops from materials I worked hard to siphon away!
Affinity_Canta_EP05_006: Would a moon snail made from the moon be the best top?
Affinity_Canta_EP05_007: Ah... I am sorry. So you are that kind of person... Somehow, I pity you.
Affinity_Canta_EP06_001: I want to draw the Dragons into the top arena. Do you know a good sucker?
Affinity_Canta_EP06_002: What are you planning this time?
Affinity_Canta_EP06_003: If I entice the Dragons to create jewel tops and metal tops, they would be incredibly powerful, do you not think?
Affinity_Canta_EP06_005: That exercise-addicted Dragon? Come to think of it, I once saw him spin a dumbbell like a top. I should approach him.
Affinity_Canta_EP06_007: That lunatic destroyed my house recently! I refuse to work with someone who demolishes a house merely by bumping shoulders!
Affinity_Canta_EP07_001: That Queen lost, so she should admit it and buy me candy! Say something to her!
Affinity_Canta_EP07_002: Perhaps challenging someone with no money was your first mistake.
Affinity_Canta_EP07_003: Ugh, tch~! Should she not refuse a contest if she has no money?
Affinity_Canta_EP07_004: The match was illegal, so it is void.
Affinity_Canta_EP07_005: A top battle is illegal? Where is such a law written?
Affinity_Canta_EP07_006: I will tell her to bring you a bag of candy by tomorrow.
Affinity_Canta_EP07_007: Make it two bags! Plum flavor! I am tired of green grape.
Affinity_Canta_EP08_001: I saw a spectacular pink person. I want to challenge them to a top battle...
Affinity_Canta_EP08_002: Pink? Did you mistake a ghost for someone else?
Affinity_Canta_EP08_003: That one merely has pink hair! The one I saw was an Elf!
Affinity_Canta_EP08_005: Probably? She looks more capable with a top than any other Elf. Introduce me.
Affinity_Canta_EP08_006: Could it be Momo? Does she spin an acorn top?
Affinity_Canta_EP08_007: She makes tops from acorns? That is fresh. What strategy might she use?
Affinity_Canta_EP09_001: The cold back alleys of the Fairy Kingdom belong to the great Canta...
Affinity_Canta_EP09_002: I thought they were Mayo's territory...
Affinity_Canta_EP09_003: That one... is honestly somewhat frightening. I know well enough to watch myself around her.
Affinity_Canta_EP09_004: ...But surely you are warm only toward your tops.
Affinity_Canta_EP09_005: Tops are tools! I am not some fool who becomes attached to objects!
Affinity_Canta_EP09_006: The Fairy Kingdom is my territory!
Affinity_Canta_EP09_007: Huh~? Is that not far too despicable for the Master? Well, I rather like you that way...
Affinity_Canta_EP10_001: What feature should I add to my top? Do you have any spectacular ideas?
Affinity_Canta_EP10_002: Make a chainsaw spring out of it.
Affinity_Canta_EP10_003: Hmm. Basic, yet efficient. I will consider it.
Affinity_Canta_EP10_005: Are you telling me to spin around like a top? Ridiculous.
Affinity_Canta_EP10_007: There is no point if my own top explodes too!
Affinity_Canta_EP11_001: Ah, is there nobody better at top battles than me? A rival would give me some stimulation.
Affinity_Canta_EP11_002: Me! Me! You cannot beat me without cheating, can you?
Affinity_Canta_EP11_003: Why does the process matter? In the end, the only fact remaining is that I won.
Affinity_Canta_EP11_004: But what if a true rival appeared?
Affinity_Canta_EP11_005: Two suns cannot rise beneath the same sky. I would not let them be...
Affinity_Canta_EP11_006: Whew, who would dare defeat you~? You truly are the Top Champion!
Affinity_Canta_EP11_007: ...Why do I feel both smug and furious...? Was that an insult or a compliment?!
Affinity_Canta_EP12_001: Master, how much would it cost for you to transfer ownership of the banquet hall? This time, I will buy it with money!
Affinity_Canta_EP12_003: What? I said it casually, but you truly might sell? You make the first offer!
Affinity_Canta_EP12_004: I told you, I have no intention of selling!
Affinity_Canta_EP12_005: What pointless resolve. When you act that way, it only makes me want it more!
Affinity_Canta_EP12_006: You have no money, do you?
Affinity_Canta_EP12_007: Just play along for once! Must you strike precisely where it hurts?
Affinity_Canta_EP13_001: Something is wrong with me... Everything keeps spinning before my eyes...
Affinity_Canta_EP13_002: Are you dizzy from staring at spinning tops?
Affinity_Canta_EP13_003: Ugh... Hearing you say that suddenly makes my stomach churn too...!
Affinity_Canta_EP13_004: Have you begun spinning like a top too?
Affinity_Canta_EP13_005: You are spinning before my eyes as well, Master. Give me a top whip, and I will strike you so you spin even faster!
Affinity_Canta_EP13_006: You are exhausted because you stayed awake battling tops!
Affinity_Canta_EP13_007: If tops are the cause of my pain, I shall embrace that pain! Such is the path of the world's strongest top battler!
Affinity_Canta_EP14_002: How much did you pay for their friendship?
Affinity_Canta_EP14_003: I know nothing about friendship fees, but I gave them a top. Then they gave me thiiis many fruits!
Affinity_Canta_EP14_005: At first glance, they looked like a monster, but they are surprisingly innocent. Curious? Hehe.
Affinity_Canta_EP14_006: Be honest. Are they a friend or a sucker?
Affinity_Canta_EP14_007: What do you take me for? A real friend! We even made a top together!
Affinity_Canta_EP15_001: Why does everyone think top battles are merely a game for children?
Affinity_Canta_EP15_002: Because they are something people play only as children?
Affinity_Canta_EP15_003: What do you mean, 'only as children'?! They remain incredibly entertaining when you are grown!
Affinity_Canta_EP15_004: People will begin seeing them differently. You are working hard.
Affinity_Canta_EP15_005: But to change their minds faster... could your banquet hall... become a top house...? No...?
Affinity_Canta_EP15_006: Because they consider tops mere toys?
Affinity_Canta_EP15_007: Adults play with toys too. What does age have to do with toys?
Affinity_Canta_EP16_001: I broke another dozen or so tops today! Hehe~
Affinity_Canta_EP16_002: Why break their tops after winning?
Affinity_Canta_EP16_003: It is my unique victory ceremony, designed to make my opponents taste the full bitterness of defeat. Hehe!
Affinity_Canta_EP16_004: That is cruel! Losing is sad enough without having your top destroyed.
Affinity_Canta_EP16_005: If they value their tops, they should not lose! Competition is merciless. It is not my fault!
Affinity_Canta_EP16_006: Oh, it sounds as though you won many times today.
Affinity_Canta_EP16_007: Naturally! All that top battling made my shoulders stiff. Master, massage them here~
Affinity_Canta_EP17_001: When there are no top matches, I have no idea what to do with my spare time.
Affinity_Canta_EP17_002: Why not enter another sporting competition?
Affinity_Canta_EP17_003: What kind? ...A kingdom-cleaning contest? That sounds terrible... What fool would enter such a contest?
Affinity_Canta_EP17_004: Go search for a place to open your top house.
Affinity_Canta_EP17_005: You said you would do that for me! Are you sneakily pushing the work back onto me?
Affinity_Canta_EP17_006: Practice your top skills. Practice is the only path forward!
Affinity_Canta_EP17_007: Ugh, what nagging! I practice perfectly well without being told. You go practice, Master!
Affinity_Canta_EP18_001: I suddenly began wondering: Why is a spinning top called a top?
Affinity_Canta_EP18_003: Mine goes flip-flop before my eyes. Sometimes it goes pit-a-pat. Yesterday it went zip-zap!
Affinity_Canta_EP18_004: Because you strike it over the top.
Affinity_Canta_EP18_005: Hmm... I hate to admit it, but that sounds remarkably plausible...
Affinity_Canta_EP18_007: Ugh, how boring! I expected some awful joke from you.
Affinity_Canta_EP19_001: What would I be doing now if I had never discovered tops?
Affinity_Canta_EP19_003: Honestly, what about me suggests that? I am a Fairy who despises loud, fast things!
Affinity_Canta_EP19_005: Oh, not bad! Honestly, if I had enough wood, I would like to make something besides tops too!
Affinity_Canta_EP19_007: What?! The three of us are equal friends! Ugh, Master... I will avenge this humiliation...
Affinity_Canta_EP20_001: Money can be won and lost in a single instant...
Affinity_Canta_EP20_002: Oh dear. One look tells me you lost a great deal today.
Affinity_Canta_EP20_003: Correct... Sigh... I want to lose myself in a rich aroma. Master, would you buy penniless little me a glass of milk...?
Affinity_Canta_EP20_004: If you lost it in your own house, does that not make things even?
Affinity_Canta_EP20_005: I feel terrible! My feelings matter! Why will you not sympathize?
Affinity_Canta_EP20_006: Tch. Bet only on the favorite next time.
Affinity_Canta_EP20_007: Where is the entertainment in that?! The thrill comes from backing an underdog and making a fortune!
